content: Patients may book appointments up to 30 days in advance through the clinic portal, mobile app, or by calling the front desk during business hours (9 AM – 6 PM, Monday to Saturday). Walk-in consultations are accepted subject to doctor availability, though advance booking is strongly recommended to secure a preferred time slot. For specialist appointments such as Cardiology or Orthopedics, booking at least 3 to 5 business days ahead is advisable due to high demand. Same-day bookings may be available for General practice slots and are granted on a first-come, first-served basis. Patients must provide their full name, date of birth, and a valid contact number when making a booking.
